notes.title: Script update
notes.content:
A small update to the script that should remove more instances of characters being referenced, whilst they were dead.

Hopefully the dead truly stay dead now!

notes.title: We would love to hear your opinion!
notes.content:
Like the Patron, we'll keep it short and blunt! We need your help and are asking you to leave a review about your experience. 

Whether positive or negative, all reviews are helpful in improving the story!

notes.title: Update 2.1.0 - Script and Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Fixed temporal time space issue with the epilogue where you are married, when you are not.
Fixed several achievements not getting unlocked when completing the game.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Unlocking Achievements
notes.content:
After receiving reports that achievements we're not getting unlocked, we investigated the issue and found the problem.

You should now be able to once again unlock all achievements! We've made sure that this process is always checked when starting the game.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Magnum Opus
notes.content:
There were old warnings of a time long gone by, these are now removed and should no longer refer to the incorrect timeline.

The player was warned about Paye no longer being able to create the Magnum Opus, this was incorrect and has been updated to the correct hints.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Bloodfest Achievement
notes.content: It was impossible to gain the Bloodfest Achievement, this has been fixed and is now available!

notes.title: Launch of the Definitive Edition
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the release of the Definitive Edition!

[b]Patch notes[/b]
- Added new epilogues.
- Added guides for the achievements in the Community Tab.
- Added Hints for the true ending.
- Fixed minor story inconsistencies.


[i]For those who own an original copy, will automatically receive an upgrade to this new version.[/i]

notes.title: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Today we are announcing the upcoming Definitive Edition, which will be released within the coming month priced at $9,99.

We have also permanently reduced the price to $9,99. Because of this price reduction we wanted to provide those who already purchased the game with a free upgrade to the Definitive Edition.

If you already completed the story, this will be a great opportunity to return and see what your actions have caused. This was one of the requested featured we received, so we wanted to provide you with a more detailed Epilogue.

In addition to these changes, the store page has also been updated to make it more clear what this game is actually all about. Originally we thought it would be great to keep a sense of mystery and not disclose the mechanics of the game. Unfortunately this has caused some confusion and kept certain players from replaying the game.

So to make it more clear:
[i]At Eve's Wake is an interactive Lovecraftian horror story about surviving a family you never knew and their servitude to a dark patron. Discover what your family knows and does to win, only to have it used against them by your actions. All this knowledge remains with you through victory or death, beyond the bounds of time and space. Armed with this knowledge, your actions will shape your fate and that of the family. Will you embrace this gift or rid humanity of their taint? [/i]
 
To stay true to the theme of Lovecraftian horror, you will be able to manipulate the fabric of reality and makes changes by returning to earlier save points. Apart from this, you will be able to use knowledge acquired from previous  play-throughs, or even current if returning to an earlier save point

So whether you are new or returning, we hope that you will enjoy the Definitive Edition!

The Sugar Rush Team

notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Happy Halloween everyone!

We are happy to announce that Steam Achievements are now available to unlock! Those that have already played the game to completion should get these retroactively.

Let us know how you like these achievements and enjoy!

notes.title: Testing Steam Achievements
notes.content: We are currently in the process of adding Steam Achievements!

notes.title: Major Update: Achievements
notes.content:
Just before the holiday season, we wanted to surprise you with an update! You can now collect in-game achievements to track your progress.

We've also fixed several minor script and grammatical errors.

Stay safe everyone and happy holidays!

Sugar Rush Studios

notes.title: Minor Update: Pronoun can now be set in Settings
notes.content: After receiving feedback on the pronoun, this will no longer be if already asked or when it has been set in the Settings. This question will now be asked only once. You can always change your preferred pronoun in the Settings under Gameplay.
